contract.backend: Triton paged BF16 CSA sparse GQA
contract.performance_scope: step15 rank0/rank1 fitted index draws at two evaluator-private index seeds; the standard evaluator geometric mean over all four shapes is the objective
contract.correctness_scope: the same four step15 single-request fitted-index shapes used for performance

tolerance_calibration.method: piped reference-vs-Triton elementwise diff on the GPU gateway
tolerance_calibration.note: the legacy atol of 0.01 is about six times the largest possible output magnitude (1.6e-3), so an elementwise gate at that value cannot fail; the calibrated atol is 3.2e-5 with rtol 0.02, a 2-20x margin over observation
